== Description ==

[[Mike Kessling]] (mid, blue New Allies tee, chin on hand), [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] (mid-right, beard, brown hair, blue zip or blue shirt, hand on face), [[Steve Harpster]] (left, white hair, glasses, black jacket, beard), and [[Sam Tashima]] (right foreground, glasses, beard, grey polo, watch, blue playmat) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
